title: Visible message actions (settings)
creator: Davidcoz
content:
In settings - Visible message actions" don't seem to work or change....selections are delete, archive, move, copy, spam. Clicking or checking some of them or changing them don't seem to have an effect on the buttons in messages.

Anyone else found this?
